title: A Comparative Study of UMAP and Other Dimensionality Reduction Methods
abstract: arXiv:2603.02275v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) is a widely used manifold learning technique for dimensionality reduction. This paper studies UMAP, supervised UMAP, and several competing dimensionality reduction methods, including Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Kernel PCA, Sliced Inverse Regression (SIR), Kernel SIR, and t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding, through a comprehensive comparative analysis. Although UMAP has attracted substantial attention for preserving local and global structures, its supervised extensions, particularly for regression settings, remain rather underexplored. We provide a systematic evaluation of supervised UMAP for both regression and classification using simulated and real datasets, with performance assessed via predictive accuracy on low-dimensional embeddings. Our results show that supervised UMAP performs well for classification but exhibits limitations in effectively incorporating r

translated_title: UMAP与其他降维方法的比较研究
translated_abstract: 均匀流形近似与投影（UMAP）是一种被广泛使用的流形学习降维技术。本文通过全面的对比分析，研究了UMAP、有监督UMAP以及多种竞争性降维方法，包括主成分分析（PCA）、核PCA、切片逆回归（SIR）、核SIR以及t分布随机邻域嵌入（t-SNE）。尽管UMAP因能够保留局部和全局结构而受到广泛关注，但其有监督扩展形式，尤其是在回归场景下的应用，仍然探索不足。我们使用模拟数据和真实数据集，对有监督UMAP在回归和分类任务中的表现进行了系统评估，并通过低维嵌入上的预测精度来衡量其性能。结果表明，有监督UMAP在分类任务中表现良好，但在有效结合回归目标方面存在局限性。
tldr: 本文系统比较了UMAP、有监督UMAP与PCA、SIR、t-SNE等多种降维方法的性能，发现有监督UMAP在分类任务中表现优异，但在回归场景下的应用存在明显局限。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares UMAP and supervised UMAP with competing dimensionality reduction methods (PCA, Kernel PCA, SIR, Kernel SIR, and t-SNE), finding that supervised UMAP performs well for classification but exhibits limitations in regression settings.
